verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax assigns rates by product type using product tax codes, with preset codes as a fallback (docs-2, docs-23, docs-12). That mechanism could cover SaaS and digital-goods classification. The API also returns a taxability_reason field explaining why a result came out as it did, including zero-tax cases (docs-13, docs-22), which gives some visibility into each determination. Missing for 10: any evidence of state-by-state SaaS taxability handling, digital-goods-specific rules, bundled-offering treatment, visible legal research or citations behind determinations, and independent corroboration that these hard cases are handled correctly.
